ios.desc:
Your thoughts move fast. Auro helps them flow.

Auro turns your voice into clear, organized text in seconds. Hit record, say what's on your mind, and Auro transcribes it, tidies it up, and hands you an instant AI summary of what actually matters. No typing, no cleanup, no losing the idea before you catch it.

It's built for fast thinkers: students, creators, founders, and anyone whose brain runs quicker than their thumbs.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Record a voice memo and get an accurate transcription right away
• Get an instant AI summary that pulls out the key points
• Turn rambling thoughts into clean, structured notes
• Capture ideas, lectures, meetings, and to-dos on the go
• Edit, organize, and find everything with ease
• Share in a tap, by message, email, or social

WHY AURO
Most voice apps stop at transcription. Auro goes further and shapes what you said into something you can use, so you're not left sorting through a wall of text later. Speak freely, and let Auro do the organizing.

Whether it's a 2am idea, a full lecture, or thinking out loud between meetings, Auro is the fastest way from "I need to remember this" to a clean, summarized note.

Speak. Summarize. Done.

Term of Use: https://bit.ly/auro-tu
